title: Notch now-playing player
brief: Redesign of Ferrocast's macOS notch now-playing player (L11: 'un poco sosa'): collapsed pill, expanded card, liquid bubble open/close springs, new-track pulse, play/pause morph, progress, equalizer, aspect-fill covers; with live motion sliders and Copy as prompt.

artboards.title: Liquid glass
artboards.tradeoff: Most expressive: gooey metaball bubble with droplets, cover-tinted glow and sheen; costs a goo filter per frame and is the hardest to reproduce natively (CAShapeLayer path morph plus 3-5 droplet layers, or a Metal/CIFilter shader).

artboards.title: Ferrocast object
artboards.tradeoff: Sober and fast: pure black, one accent progress line as the hero, mono micro-labels, one white pill action; less wow and less bubble feel. Easy in AppKit (CALayer plus CASpringAnimation, no blur).

artboards.title: Vinyl / ambient
artboards.tradeoff: Most emotional and legible: spinning vinyl disc with progress ring, ambient artwork halo and bold title; tallest card (216 pt) and colour competes with the desktop. Medium AppKit effort (masked rotating layer, CAShapeLayer arc, cached blur).
